mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attachments ( post_id, original_name, file_size, file_type, upload_type, file_data, download_count, is_deleted, created_at ) VALUES ( #{post_id}, #{original_name}, #{file_size}, #{file_type}, #{upload_type}, #{file_data}, #{download_count}, #{is_deleted}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT attachment_id, post_id, original_name, file_size, file_type, upload_type, file_data, download_count, is_deleted, created_at, deleted_at FROM attachments WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND is_deleted = 'N'
